rules.text: The centre is open Monday to Saturday.

rules.text: The centre is open 07:00 to 19:00 on weekdays and 08:00 to 12:00 on Saturday.

rules.subject: appointment-slot
rules.text: A therapy session is 45 minutes long.

rules.subject: booking
rules.text: Patients can book up to 21 days ahead.

rules.subject: cancellation
rules.text: Patients can cancel up to 12 hours before the session.

rules.subject: booking
rules.text: A booking needs a name, a phone number and the injury area.

rules.subject: booking
rules.text: A patient can book at most 2 sessions per phone number per week.
